Indian Army TGC 145 Examination 2026 : Short Details
Apply Online Start Date : 30 September 2026
Last Date For Fee Payment : 29 October 2026
Candidates are advised to confirm from the Indian Army TGC-145th official website.
No application fee is required for any candidate.
Indian Army provides age relaxation for the TGC-145th position as per their regulations.
Candidates must have a B.E./B.Tech or M.Sc. degree in Computer Science in the notified engineering streams as specified in the notification.
Candidates who have completed or are in the final year of their Engineering degree in the relevant field from an AICTE-approved college or institute are eligible for the Technical Graduate Course 145th.
